templateAuthor.acknowledged.en: The server acknowledged this request. Publication or review approval is not confirmed.
templateAuthor.acknowledged.zh-Hans: 服务器已接收请求，但尚未确认发布或审核通过。

templateAuthor.httpReview.en: Review the exact request before submitting. Server approval may still be required.
templateAuthor.httpReview.zh-Hans: 提交前请核对请求，仍可能需要服务器审核。

templateAuthor.shelf.limit.en: This shelf reads the first 100 templates. Missing rows do not prove deletion from a full page.
templateAuthor.shelf.limit.zh-Hans: 此列表仅读取前100个模板。满页中未出现的模板不能据此认定已删除。

templateAuthor.shelf.outLibrary.en: Not marked as in template library
templateAuthor.shelf.outLibrary.zh-Hans: 未标记为已加入模板库

templateAuthor.shelf.deleteReview.en: Delete this exact template from your own shelf? This may not be reversible.
templateAuthor.shelf.deleteReview.zh-Hans: 确定删除此编号的我的模板？此操作可能无法撤销。

templateAuthor.shelf.addReview.en: Set this exact template’s library status to 1 (in library).
templateAuthor.shelf.addReview.zh-Hans: 将此编号模板的模板库状态设为1（加入模板库）。

templateAuthor.shelf.removeReview.en: Set this exact template’s library status to 0 (out of library).
templateAuthor.shelf.removeReview.zh-Hans: 将此编号模板的模板库状态设为0（移出模板库）。

templateAuthor.shelf.readback.en: The exact template will be checked before sending, then the shelf will be refreshed. An uncertain response locks further changes.
templateAuthor.shelf.readback.zh-Hans: 发送前将核对此编号模板，随后刷新列表。结果不确定时会锁定后续修改。

templateAuthor.shelf.verified.en: The request was acknowledged and the fresh own-shelf state matches the requested change.
templateAuthor.shelf.verified.zh-Hans: 请求已获确认，刷新后的我的模板状态与所请求的修改一致。

templateAuthor.shelf.unknown.en: This change is unresolved. Further shelf changes are locked; refreshing alone cannot confirm an unknown request.
templateAuthor.shelf.unknown.zh-Hans: 此次修改结果尚未确定，后续模板修改已锁定。仅刷新列表不能确认未知请求结果。

templateAuthor.shelf.stale.en: This template changed since review. Refresh and review it again. Nothing was sent.
templateAuthor.shelf.stale.zh-Hans: 此模板在核对后已变化。请刷新并重新核对，尚未发送修改请求。

templateAuthor.shelf.preflightFailed.en: The fresh template or secure pending record could not be verified. No change was sent.
templateAuthor.shelf.preflightFailed.zh-Hans: 无法核验最新模板或安全待处理记录，未发送修改请求。

templateAuthor.shelf.empty.en: Your own template shelf is empty.

templateAuthor.shelf.pageScope.en: Browse 10 at a time, up to 1,000 per search. Changes require a matching first-100 owner snapshot.
templateAuthor.shelf.pageScope.zh-Hans: 每页显示 10 项，每次搜索最多 1,000 项。修改需要与前 100 项的所有者快照一致。

templateAuthor.shelf.moreFailed.en: Could not load the next page. Retry or refresh the list.
templateAuthor.shelf.moreFailed.zh-Hans: 下一页加载失败，请重试或刷新列表。

templateAuthor.shelf.pageLimit.en: Search limit reached. Narrow your search or refresh.
templateAuthor.shelf.pageLimit.zh-Hans: 已达到搜索上限，请缩小搜索范围或刷新。
